description: Regional roads on the territory of the City of Brussels is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Roads managed by the Brussels Capital Region. Some roads (streets, highways, avenues, boulevards, squares,...) are located on the territory of the City; other roads may be adjacent. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are road network. The portal shows 2,030 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
